content_text: Tends to be a practical issue involving the space restrictions. Sometimes you don’t have the room to back up a light to fill a bounce surface so you’re better off with multiple smaller lights closer. But that’s the nice thing about a big diffused light, you can always add another light into the mix to increase the output if you’ve fallen short.
